site_recommendation.material: 夯土外墙黄褐，石基灰褐，环形瓦顶深灰，正门外围暗赭红、灰白门套；上层小窗框浅灰。
site_recommendation.lineDetail: Landscape 1536x1024. Follow the near-frontal exterior reference, NOT an invented aerial cutaway. ONE complete cylindrical tulou with FOUR floor levels, three upper rows of small rectangular windows, low continuous circular sloping tile roof and the main entrance as photographed. Keep the curved wall across its full width; no neighbouring tulous, courtyard reconstruction or central palace.
site_recommendation.lede: 一圈黄褐夯土墙收拢数百间房，瓦檐沿圆周轻轻挑出。承启楼以四层外环与层层内院，容纳了永定山间的共同生活。
facts: 营建 明代开始兴建，1709年建成，位于永定高北村，是福建土楼遗产的组成部分。
空间 外环四层，内部多重环形院落及中心祖堂；本图只表现完整外观，不做假想剖切。
材料 夯土外墙、石质墙基、木构居住层与环形瓦顶共同构成土楼。
